strategic_horizon.medium_term_goal: Prove the first real industry benchmark end-to-end: archived original evidence must support no-lookahead Reality + Expectation + Outcome replay across a meaningful cycle, using reusable primitives rather than lithium-specific hacks.
strategic_horizon.short_term_goal: Prove the evidence-final transition on the first sealed shard. UP-CHEMICALS blind memory is frozen at 81 raw / 53 formal within the campaign checkpoint of 683 raw / 625 formal / 58 legacy. Run shard-scoped fresh discovery only for UP-CHEMICALS and turn replay-critical leads into exact primary-source targets without promoting search results to facts.
strategic_horizon.next_big_step: Convert self-verification discovery into claim-scoped evidence tasks, archive original sources with valid-time and known-time semantics, then assemble the first no-lookahead Reality + Expectation + Outcome replay slice. The other 13 shards remain search-isolated until independently sealed.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not reopen sealed blind memory because search finds better wording or later facts. Search is discovery, archived source evidence decides publishable truth, and not_found is not false. Stop broad search that does not improve exact source targeting or replay-critical evidence coverage.
parallel_permanent_tracks: Keep current-source collection source-first/archive-now so today's original material does not become tomorrow's recovery gap.

The highest-value next proof is no longer more recall; it is demonstrating that frozen memory can drive precise, auditable evidence discovery without hindsight contaminating the original research vintage.

Search outputs remain discovery-only, the blind atlas is unchanged, and hard CI is green.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: Refresh CI after the mixed-phase boundary test and handoff sync. Then run fresh web discovery only for UP-CHEMICALS-SV-001 query families SVQ-001 through SVQ-006, favoring primary company/regulatory/government domains and dated historical documents, and persist discovery-v1.json without creating Facts or Judgments.
